items.name: Solar Consultation & Energy Assessment
bullets: Understand your energy goals and constraints
Review existing power setup, if any
Outline suitable solution directions
No-obligation next steps toward a site assessment
items.d: A conversation about your property, energy needs, application and budget — the starting point for every project.

items.name: Site Survey
bullets: Roof/ground structural and orientation check
Load or water-yield assessment as relevant
Site constraints, access and shading review
Findings feed directly into system design
items.d: An on-site assessment of your roof, ground, water source or facility to confirm what a design can actually work with.

items.name: Solar System Design & Site Layout
bullets: Array layout matched to your roof or ground plan
Inverter and storage configuration
Equipment specification sized to your requirement
Design reviewed with you before sourcing begins
items.d: A layout and system architecture designed specifically for your site — not a generic package.

items.name: Equipment Sourcing
bullets: Equipment matched to your approved design
Sourced to suit your budget and requirement
Technical suitability checked before order
Brand relationships confirmed on a per-project basis
items.d: We source suitable equipment for your design, matched to application, budget and availability.

items.name: Professional Installation & Commissioning
bullets: Installation scheduled around your site needs
System commissioning and function checks
Site handover and orientation
Documentation appropriate to your project
items.d: Installation and commissioning carried out by our technical team, to the design specification.

items.name: Maintenance, Support & Troubleshooting
bullets: Fault diagnosis and troubleshooting
Routine maintenance visits
Support requests via WhatsApp or phone
Guidance on system care between visits
items.d: Ongoing support to keep your system performing as designed.

items.name: System Upgrades & Optimisation
bullets: Assess current system against new requirements
Battery, inverter or array expansion design
Sourcing and installation of upgrade components
Advice on sequencing upgrades to your budget
items.d: As your needs, budget or property change, we assess and design system upgrades.
